svg.text: Text bananabananabandanas$. Unary chains of the trie are merged into one edge;
each edge is stored as a half-open interval [start, end) of the text (grey, under the edge).
v1..v12: internal nodes, squares: leaves with suffix start. 34 nodes, 33 edges.
Coloured: search paths; ✗c marks the mismatching character c.
